newsitem.title: USA: Soligen sees break-even fiscal Q4 1997.
newsitem.headline: Soligen sees break-even fiscal Q4 1997.

text.p: Soligen Technologies Inc on Friday said it expected to report break-even results for the fourth quarter of fiscal 1997, ending March 31, after a loss of $0.04 per share in the same period a year ago.
"Soligen's sales have been improving steadily throughout the year, while our operating losses have substantially narrowed," Yehoram Uziel, chief executive officer, said in a statement.
Total revenues are expected to increase to about $1.58 million from $753,000 one year ago.
